# contract-legal-review

> Public WorkBuddy contract legal review V2.1 skill. Read SKILL.md first, download the complete repository, then run its local Python scripts. Python 3.10+; pypdf is optional for PDFs. Fixed offline editor, preferences, perspectives, revisions and re-review handoff. This is a fixed three-law snapshot.

## Entry points
- [Skill instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/main/SKILL.md)
- [Human installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/main/README.md)
- [Full repository ZIP](https://github.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)
